remarks: Incredible opportunity at Park Tower Stamford. This spacious 2-bedroom Penthouse condominium showcases sweeping views of Long Island Sound and the Manhattan skyline. Soaring 9-foot ceilings and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows fill the space with natural light. With an open layout and blank canvas design, it's ready for you to bring your vision to life and create the home you've always imagined. Grab a drink and head to the balcony to watch spectacular sunsets over the water and cityscape. Perfectly located across from Mill River Park in the heart of downtown Stamford, you're just steps from dining, shopping, and year-round entertainment. Enjoy luxury living with resort-style amenities including a rooftop terrace with panoramic NYC views, all-season indoor pool, fitness center, stylish resident lounge, and 24/7 white glove concierge service. A free building shuttle takes you to the Metro North train-just 55 minutes to NYC. Pet-friendly building with parking available. At this price, it's the perfect chance to transform a top-floor home in one of Stamford's most desirable full-service buildings.
